Meet Your Host

Gist and Giggle
with Skelebobo

The program will delve into the struggles and joy of being a Christian and how to walk with God to find your purpose and identity.

Don't miss out! Join the conversation and stay connected with the Local African Professionals community!

Follow us:

1:00PM - 2:00PM EVERY THURSDAY

Heartlines

Guests will draw from their personal and professional experiences to address key issues impacting African communities in the UK — including immigration, social services, health, education, employment, and the use of professional networks — while also exploring spiritual matters and major challenges faced by the community.
